requirements.quote: No provider sets `relays` (bin/lean/sandbox-remote.mjs), so `placeLane` (bin/lean/execution.mjs:226-229) pins every capability lane local.

Add a provider `relays` entry with a host-side gate: the sandbox calls back through the computeshare router (bin/pool/router.mjs) to the dispatching host, which runs only an allowlisted read-only command (e.g. the `obs-psql`/`obs-*` wrappers) and returns the output.
The key never leaves the host.
Pre-fetch: for contract steps that name a read-only query, the host runs it at dispatch and ships the output with the lane.
Acceptance: the read-only relay works end to end with an allowlist test (non-allowlisted commands refused).

deliverables.change: New pure/deterministic module (0 LLM). (a) `parseRelayCommands(list)`: `capability:command` entries (same idiom as host_capability_patterns) -> `{capability: [command...]}`. A command is an exact name, or a prefix glob ending in a single trailing `*` (e.g. `obs-*`). Names may not contain `/`, whitespace or other glob chars. Invalid entries are ignored. (b) `relayGate(argv, relay)` -> `{ok:true, capability}` only when argv is a non-empty string array, argv[0] contains no `/` and matches an entry exactly or by prefix glob; otherwise `{ok:false, reason}`. (c) `runRelayed(argv, {timeoutMs=120000, maxBytes=1048576, secrets, execFileFn})` runs the gated argv via execFile with `shell:false`, the host env, timeout and output cap. It returns `{rc, stdout, stderr, truncated?}` with every known secret redacted (reuse sandbox-remote `redact`). A refused argv never spawns and returns `{rc:126, stderr:'relay: <cmd> not allowlisted'}`. (d) `relayPrefetchCommands({comments}, relay)`: from the last parseable `<!-- FORGE:CONTRACT -->` comment (parseContractComment from render.mjs), take each validate `command` and `repro_test.command` that is a single simple command (no `| ; & < > $ backtick` or newline outside quotes, tokenised with a minimal single/double-quote splitter) whose argv passes relayGate. Return `[{argv}]`. (e) `servicePending({transport, id, relay, run})`: list the sandbox's pending requests, then gate+run each (or refuse) and post the answer. All errors are swallowed (the next poll retries).

httpTransport: add `relayPending(id)` (GET /sandboxes/:id/relay -> `{requests:[{rid, argv}]}`; a 404/405 or malformed reply gives [], so an old router is unsupported, not an error) and `relayAnswer(id, rid, {rc, stdout, stderr})` (POST /sandboxes/:id/relay/:rid). Update the protocol doc comment. remoteProvider: expose `relays` = sorted capabilities that have at least one relay command, and only when `transport.relayPending` exists (otherwise []). In `start()`, add `CS_RELAY_COMMANDS` (comma list of the exact, non-glob command names, used for shims), `CS_RELAY_CAPS` (comma list of relayed capabilities) and, when `settings.prefetch?.(issue)` returns commands, run each via relay.mjs runRelayed on the host before launch and ship `CS_RELAY_PREFETCH_B64` (base64 JSON `[{argv, rc, stdout, stderr}]`; entries that would push the total past 96 KB are dropped). Remember every value in the redaction set. In `status(h)`, after pullLogs, call relay.mjs servicePending with the provider's known secrets (errors swallowed, never changes the returned status). No host secret, key or credential value is ever put in the spec; the only output that leaves is the redacted output of an allowlisted command.

parseExecution: read `relay_commands` (list or comma string of `capability:command`) via relay.mjs parseRelayCommands. Keep only capabilities matching CAPABILITY_RE. Return `relay` only when non-empty (spread like hostCapabilities). providerByName: pass `settings.relay` through and accept `opts.prefetch` (issue -> commands) into the remote/pool provider settings. Update the #4542 header comment (`a sandbox relays none` -> relayed via execution.relay_commands, #4778). placeLane itself is unchanged: it already places a need that is in `relays` by the normal rules.

In readBody (:1820-1821), also fill a per-issue `prefetchOf` map with relay.mjs relayPrefetchCommands(v, exec.relay) when exec.relay is set. Pass `prefetch: (n) => prefetchOf.get(n) ?? []` to execMod.providerByName (:~1604). For the lane side, wherever readHostCaps feeds `o.hostCaps` for runCore, also pass `relayCaps` parsed from env `CS_RELAY_CAPS` (comma list; empty/unset = []).

At the #4785 gate (:1607-1610), drop capabilities in `o.relayCaps` from `contractHostNeeds(frozen, o.hostCaps).caps` (and their ids) before deciding to end env.capability_remote, so a remote lane whose validate command uses a relayed capability builds in the sandbox. Leave `hostCapabilityBlock` at :869 unchanged (a failed relay still recovers locally once). Document the new `o.relayCaps` option in the runCore JSDoc next to `o.hostCaps` (:202).

In-memory per-sandbox relay queue (not persisted; a router restart drops pending requests and the sandbox's cs-relay times out). Routes: agent auth `POST /agent/relay/:id` {argv} -> 202 {rid}. It is accepted only when the sandbox is known and placed on the calling agent (agentFor(req) === sbx[id].agent; else 404). It rejects with 400 a non-array argv, more than 64 args, or more than 16 KB JSON, and with 429 when 8 requests are already pending for that sandbox. Agent auth `GET /agent/relay/:id/:rid` -> {state:'pending'} or {state:'done', rc, stdout, stderr} (removed once read), with the same ownership check. ForgeDock auth `GET /sandboxes/:id/relay` -> {requests:[{rid, argv}]} of unanswered requests. ForgeDock auth `POST /sandboxes/:id/relay/:rid` {rc, stdout, stderr} -> 200 and marks the request done (404 for an unknown rid). Drop a sandbox's queue when the sandbox is deleted. The router never executes or gates commands. Use `own()` lookups for all caller-supplied keys. rid is from randomBytes.

Give each sandbox `CS_RELAY_BASE` = `http://host.docker.internal:<port>/sandboxes/<id>/relay` next to CS_CRED_BASE (:114). In `handle` (:373-378), before the agent-token check, accept sandbox-credToken-authenticated `POST /sandboxes/:id/relay` and `GET /sandboxes/:id/relay/:rid` (same check as sandboxCred: known, not exited, sameSecret credToken; else 401). Forward them to the router `/agent/relay/:id[/:rid]` with the agent token and return the router's status/body. The agent never executes the command.

New bash script (SPDX header like cs-cred). `cs-relay <cmd> [args...]`: build argv JSON with `jq -n '$ARGS.positional' --args -- "$@"`. If CS_RELAY_PREFETCH_B64 has an entry with an identical argv, print its stdout/stderr and exit with its rc. Otherwise POST {argv} to $CS_RELAY_BASE with `authorization: Bearer $CS_CRED_TOKEN`, then poll `$CS_RELAY_BASE/<rid>` every 2s up to CS_RELAY_TIMEOUT_S (default 300). On done, print stdout to stdout and stderr to stderr and exit rc. On no relay, HTTP error or timeout, print `relay unavailable: ...` to stderr and exit 125.

For each name in CS_RELAY_COMMANDS (comma list; only names matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$), write /opt/cs/bin/<name> = `#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec cs-relay <name> "$@"` (chmod 0755), so the builder runs `obs-psql ...` unchanged.
COPY cs-relay /usr/local/bin/cs-relay and add it to the chmod 0755 line (:40-44).

Add an `execution.relay_commands` row next to host_capabilities (:899-900) covering: format `capability:command`, `name*` prefix glob, list only read-only wrappers (never sops/ops_credentials), the host runs them with no shell and a 120s timeout and 1 MB output cap with redaction, a refused command gets rc 126, pre-fetch of simple frozen validate commands, and that an old router/agent falls back to local recovery. Fix the host_capabilities row's 'relay none of them' wording.
Append a #4778 section (relay flow sandbox -> agent -> router queue <- dispatcher poll, gate, pre-fetch, CS_RELAY_CAPS lane gate, 0 LLM cost) and fix the 'computeshare relays none' sentence at :1806.
Mention `cs-relay` (read-only capability relay, allowlisted and executed on the dispatching host) next to cs-cred at :6.

preserve.what: placeLane (bin/lean/execution.mjs:290) signature and results for every input without relays: a need not in `relays` stays local with reason `host capability: <names>`.

httpTransport existing methods and capacity() (#4540/#4547/#4788) behaviour, and remoteProvider.status return values (running|gone|exited) and transport-error propagation used by providerLanes' unreachable window (#4672). Relay servicing must never throw out of status().

Router auth model (bin/pool/router.mjs handle): forgedock routes require forgedock_token, agent routes require an enrolled agent token. Sandboxes never receive the router, agent or forgedock token (bin/tests/computeshare.test.mjs:183 'sandbox gets a per-sandbox credential relay, never the router or agent token').
lean.mjs endBlocked hostCapabilityBlock recovery (:869): a remote credentials block naming a declared capability still ends env.capability_remote, relayed or not.
parseExecution output for configs without relay_commands is deep-equal to today's (no new key emitted).
Lane spec env stays scopedEnv-only plus the existing CS_* and GIT_* keys; the new CS_RELAY_* values contain no host secret.
fix(execution): host-capability placement reads only the issue body; contract validate commands and decision comments are ignored (#4785, PR #4790)
perf(execution): pin host capabilities by need, not by mention in the issue body (#4776, PR #4795)

validate.command: node --test --test-concurrency=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2} bin/engine/telemetry-seam.test.mjs bin/lean/batch.test.mjs bin/lean/checks.test.mjs bin/lean/conformance.test.mjs bin/lean/context.test.mjs bin/lean/drift.test.mjs bin/lean/fixround.test.mjs bin/lean/execution.e2e.test.mjs bin/lean/conformance.e2e.test.mjs bin/tests/router.test.mjs

decisions.choice: Pull-based relay: the router only queues requests, and the dispatcher picks them up on its existing per-lane status poll and posts answers back. The dispatching host opens no inbound port and the router never executes anything.
decisions.justification: The dispatcher already polls the router for every live sandbox (bin/lean/execution.mjs providerLanes wait -> remoteProvider.status, bin/lean/sandbox-remote.mjs:164-169, which already pulls logs there). The router is the only party both sides reach (bin/pool/router.mjs:219-265). The key and the wrapper stay on the host, which satisfies 'the key never leaves the host'.

decisions.choice: Sandbox -> agent -> router hop authenticated with the existing per-sandbox CS_CRED_TOKEN, mirroring the credential relay.
decisions.justification: bin/pool/agent.mjs:114 and :233-245 already authenticate sandbox callbacks this way and forward to the router with the agent token. pool/image/cs-cred is the curl+jq precedent for the in-sandbox script.

decisions.choice: Allowlist is opt-in per capability in forge.yaml `execution.relay_commands` as flat `capability:command` entries (exact name or trailing-* prefix glob, no path separators). The gate is host-side, and the command is executed with execFile shell:false, a 120s timeout and a 1 MB cap. Read-only is a property of the operator's wrapper and is documented as such. sops/ops_credentials are never relayed unless explicitly listed.
decisions.justification: Same flat `name:value` idiom as `host_capability_patterns` (bin/lean/execution.mjs:113-115, docs/CONFIG.md:900). A shell-free argv gate makes metacharacter injection inert. The NORTHSTAR non-negotiable 'Deterministic first' means 0 LLM calls.

decisions.choice: A new module bin/lean/relay.mjs instead of growing execution.mjs or sandbox-remote.mjs.
decisions.justification: execution.mjs is 634 lines with many concerns. relay.mjs holds the gate, runner and pre-fetch so they can be unit tested in isolation. sandbox-remote.mjs imports from execution.mjs already (:21), so relay.mjs imports only redact from sandbox-remote.mjs and parseContractComment from render.mjs, with no import cycle into execution.mjs.

decisions.choice: Pre-fetch only simple single commands from the frozen contract (validate + repro_test) whose argv passes the same gate, shipped in env CS_RELAY_PREFETCH_B64 capped at 96 KB. Anything else is served live by the relay.
decisions.justification: The contract commands come from the same FORGE:CONTRACT read placementText uses (bin/lean/execution.mjs:255-264, bin/engine-cli.mjs:1820-1821; no extra gh call). The 96 KB cap stays under Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KB) for one env string written via the agent's --env-file (bin/pool/agent.mjs:111-115).

decisions.choice: A relayed capability skips only the #4785 pre-build end (contractHostNeeds), not the hostCapabilityBlock recovery.
decisions.justification: If the relay is unreachable (old router/agent: cs-relay exits 125), the builder blocks as credentials and lean.mjs:869 still recovers the lane locally once. Degradation is the same as today.
